response.justification: While Bogdan brings valuable geospatial expertise and demonstrates strong software fundamentals as a senior engineer, he lacks the primary required skill set for this role. The position explicitly requires modern C++ or Rust expertise as the foundation technology, and his C++ experience is limited to a 2014-2015 role; the past decade of work emphasizes web and application development (TypeScript, Node.js, React) rather than systems-level programming. Combined with his lack of navigation/routing domain experience and recent career trajectory away from performance-critical systems work, the gap between his current capabilities and this mid-senior IC role's core requirements is too significant for the position.
strengths: Deep geospatial/GIS expertise with production platform experience (GISCollective), providing valuable domain context for routing systems
Senior-level distributed systems experience managing microservices handling millions of requests/second, demonstrating systems thinking at scale
Proven software craftsmanship with demonstrated ability to learn new technologies across diverse domains (web, mobile, embedded, infrastructure)
concerns: No modern C++ or Rust experience; C++ work limited to 2014-2015, leaving primary required technology unmet for this systems programming role
No navigation/routing domain experience; GIS platform development fundamentally differs from routing tile optimization and data pipeline work
Recent decade focused on web/application development diverges from systems-level, performance-critical, and low-latency pipeline engineering required
